title: ConstantSolverContract
description: Interface contract for the fast hybrid Diophantine and SMT constant solver in oeis-learn Phase 4

wat_skeleton.description: WebAssembly Text program containing 1 to 4 'i64.const_?' placeholder tokens

target_terms.description: Few-shot ground-truth integer sequence terms Y = [y_0, ..., y_19]

smt_timeout_ms.description: Maximum execution time allocated to Z3 SMT fallback in milliseconds

prefer_diophantine.description: Whether to attempt fast HNF Diophantine reduction before falling back to SMT

is_sat.description: Whether an exact integer constant solution was successfully recovered

solver_type.description: Engine utilized to resolve the constants

constants.description: Recovered concrete 64-bit integer values C* matching placeholders in order

grounded_wat.description: Complete executable WAT code with solved constants spliced in

solve_duration_ms.description: Elapsed solver execution time in milliseconds

error_message.description: Diagnostic message in case of unsatisfiability or timeout
